title: Circular queue in a fixed buffer
summary: Enqueue at the logical back and dequeue from the front. Track the size so a capacity-one queue can distinguish full from empty.
triggers: bounded FIFO queue with reusable slots
front and back wrap around a fixed buffer
prompts: A sensor has room for a fixed number of pending readings. Reject writes while it is full.
Implement a bounded event queue whose oldest slot can be reused after a read.
invariant: The next write goes size positions after head, modulo capacity.
mantra: Wrap the index and count the live entries.
pitfalls: A stored None is a valid item. Test size to detect an empty queue.

anchors.name: Design Circular Queue
anchors.trick: Compute the tail from the head and size.

mutations.explanation: Ignores the moved head and overwrites a live entry after a dequeue.

test: raise AssertionError("removed from an empty queue")
